name: Waldsalettl
kurzbeschreibung: Small café in the hamlet of Omes near Axams with a sun terrace, views of the Kalkkögel, homemade pastries and a forest playground.
beschreibung:
The Café Waldsalettl is located in the small hamlet of Omes in the municipality of Axams, between Axams and Kematen in the western Mittelgebirge near Innsbruck. The small, fine café offers around 40 indoor seats as well as a sun terrace with sweeping views of the Kalkkögel and into the Sellraintal valley. Directly opposite is the Omes forest playground, which is why the establishment is especially popular with families.

The kitchen focuses on fresh, regional and homemade dishes. Particularly in demand are the homemade pastries and cakes as well as the Törggele and Jausen creations. Under the motto “Whoever finds it will love it”, the Waldsalettl presents itself as a cosy insider tip away from the major routes.
